description: Use when you must vet several domains at once (vendors, leads, lookalikes): up to 10 domains in one POST, each answered exactly like /domain/report. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /domain/report/batch, $0.05 per call), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For one domain use domain_report. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.
